parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top or side of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or horizontally when pressed, returning to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the toilet tank, usually made of plastic or ceramic, covering the tank to protect internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover to prevent debris from entering the tank and provides a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and base structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste into the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to plumbing.
